descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii de inginerie
As an established German consulting firm, we are expanding our international footprint and scaling our dedicated Tech Hub in Cluj-Napoca, Romania . As part of this growing engineering hub, you will play a key role in designing and delivering modern, scalable data platforms and cloud-based analytics solutions for international clients across Europe.
 Our mission:
 We will design and build robust, end-to-end data platforms and business intelligence architectures centered around Microsoft Fabric, SQL Server, and Power BI - transforming raw data sources into intuitive, enterprise-grade management dashboards and analytical products.
 We will work together on:
 Lakehouse & Warehouse Architecture: Design and deploy modern data lakehouse and warehouse solutions within Microsoft Fabric (utilizing OneLake, Data Factory pipelines, and Spark notebooks).
 Data Pipelines & Modeling: Develop automated ETL/ELT pipelines, implement dimensional modeling (Star Schema), and ensure rigorous data quality, reliability, and monitoring.
 Semantic Models & Reporting: Build scalable Power BI semantic models, advanced DAX measures, Power Query transformations, and robust row-level security (RLS) frameworks.
 Database Integration & Optimization: Integrate, tune, and optimize relational and cloud database engines (SQL Server, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL).
 Client & Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner directly with business units to capture requirements, define core KPIs, design interactive reports, and lead technical handovers to client teams.
 Must-have:
 4+ years of professional experience in Business Intelligence and Data Engineering, with deep expertise in Power BI (complex DAX, data modeling, performance tuning).
 Hands-on project experience with Microsoft Fabric and/or modern lakehouse environments.
 Solid software foundation: Strong proficiency in Python and API integration/development (e.g., FastAPI).
 Database & Data Modeling Mastery: Expert-level SQL skills, proven experience with relational databases, dimensional modeling, and end-to-end ETL/ELT architecture.
 Business Translation: Proven ability to bridge the gap between technical data layers and business outcomes by translating ambiguous business questions into actionable metrics and KPIs.
 Communication: Fluency in English (written and spoken) with strong presentation and client-facing skills. (German language skills are a plus, but not required).
 Nice-to-have:
Experience with PySpark, Databricks, or Azure Synapse Analytics .
Familiarity with modern data orchestration and transformation tools such as dbt and Apache Airflow .
Knowledge of enterprise data governance ( Microsoft Purview ) as well as capacity and cost optimization in Fabric.
Relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g., PL-300 , DP-600 , DP-700 ).
